function.name: create_event
function.description: Create a calendar event and return its event id.

date.description: Date of the event, as YYYY-MM-DD.

start_time.description: Start time on a 24-hour clock, as HH:MM.

duration_hours.description: Length of the event in hours, for example 0.5 or 1.5.

attendee_ids.description: Contact ids of the people invited, as returned by search_contacts.
